release_notes:
## Declining the overwrite prompt is no longer slow
- Saying No used to make the app search the project for already-nested episodes a SECOND time — once to decide whether to show you the prompt, then again the moment nesting started. It now carries the first answer forward, so the search happens once per nest instead of twice
- A reel where every episode already exists and you chose not to overwrite now skips straight to reporting that. It was still working out the exact start and end timecode of every episode it had already decided not to create, which cost a request to Premiere per title card
- Resuming a stopped nest still re-reads the project, since a lot can change between stopping and continuing
